summary: Sun Life Financial Inc. announced via Form 6-K (Canadian equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) its intention to redeem all C$500 million principal amount of Series 2021-1 Subordinated Unsecured 2.46% Fixed/Floating Debentures on November 18, 2026, the optional redemption date. Redemption price equals principal plus accrued unpaid interest, funded from existing cash and liquid assets, with formal notice delivered per the trust indenture. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock disclosed. Watch liability-management cadence, refinancing spread versus the 2.46% coupon, and any replacement Tier 2 issuance signaling capital priorities.
